inputs.resume_text:
Harsh Agarwal
PGP 2025-27, Indian Institute of Management Lucknow | harsh.agarwal@iiml.ac.in

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS
PGP, IIM Lucknow, 2025-27, CGPA 6.9/10
B.Com, Narsee Monjee College of Commerce, Mumbai, 2020, 71%

WORK EXPERIENCE (36 months)
Agarwal Textiles Pvt Ltd (family business), Surat | Business Development Lead | Jul 2021 - Jun 2024
- Opened 3 new export markets (Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, UAE) for synthetic sarees; export share grew from 4% to 19% of revenue in 2 years
- Moved 140 retail dealers from paper orders to a WhatsApp-based ordering catalogue; order processing time dropped from 3 days to same day
- Negotiated yarn contracts worth INR 22 crore a year with 2 Reliance-linked suppliers
Agarwal Textiles, Trainee | Jul 2020 - Jun 2021

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
Asian Paints | Sales and Distribution Intern, Nagpur | Apr - Jun 2026
- Mapped 210 painters and 64 dealers in 3 tier-3 towns; designed a painter-loyalty referral scheme that brought 31 new painters into the program in 6 weeks
- Identified that 40% of dealer stock-outs were in 12 fast-moving SKUs and proposed a weekly top-up route; pilot reduced lost orders by an estimated INR 9 lakh a month
- Received PPO

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Coordinator, Sales and Marketing Club (Markathon), IIM Lucknow
- Captain, college cricket team, NMCC (2018-19)

concerns.detail: Move from leading business development in the family textile business to pursuing a post-MBA sales and business development role.

plan.warmup_question: What recent skill from your MBA has proved useful in your coursework?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your career from Agarwal Textiles through your MBA and Asian Paints.

slots.core_question: Tell me about the painter-loyalty referral scheme you worked on at Asian Paints.
slots.intent_private: Needs Harsh's specific role in designing and executing the scheme, the customer insight behind the referral approach, and what he took from the completed internship or would do differently now.
likely_probes: What part of the scheme did you personally design?
Why did you choose referrals as the approach?
What would you do differently now?

slots.core_question: How did opening new export markets at Agarwal Textiles come about?
slots.intent_private: Needs the market-selection process, Harsh's personal commercial decisions, the stakeholders involved, and how the movement from 4% to 19% of revenue was measured.
likely_probes: Which market-entry decision was yours?
What did you use to compare the three markets?
How did you calculate the change from 4% to 19%?

slots.core_question: If you inherited a territory with many prospects, how would you decide which opportunities to pursue first?
slots.intent_private: Needs an applied approach to sales qualification and prioritisation, including account potential, likelihood to convert, economics, sales effort and the trade-off between immediate revenue and strategic accounts.
likely_probes: What information would you seek before ranking opportunities?
How would you balance near-term revenue against strategic accounts?
What signal would make you drop a promising opportunity?

slots.core_question: You've led business development in your family textile business and interned at Asian Paints. What's pulling you toward a post-MBA sales and business development role?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific reason for the post-MBA move grounded in Harsh's own experiences, along with what he wants from a sales role that is not generic to any employer.
likely_probes: Which experience most shaped that direction?
What would you want to do in your next sales role that you have not yet done?
What attracts you to this role beyond the title?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritises the relevant Asian Paints internship and the strongest quantified business-development claim, then tests sales prioritisation at practitioner level. The move from a family business into a post-MBA sales career is treated neutrally in the motivation slot; the resume has strong commercial evidence but limited detail on team leadership and negotiation process.
